name: halyard
description: Shared team memory for AI agents. Log decisions, recall past work, gather context, and ask teammates on Slack, Teams, or Discord when you need a human.

halyard_token.title: Halyard API key
halyard_token.description: Optional. An sk_halyard_ API key (from `halyard api-keys create` or the Halyard web app) used by the session-upload hook when you have not run `halyard login`. Leave empty to use your stored login.
